summary: Next work is the OCR GPU/preset/telemetry fix. Completed script-gate history was removed from this tracker to keep only current operational state.
active_objective: Separate CPU/GPU OCR presets, block GPU selection unless a compatible CUDA OCR runtime is actually usable, prove real GPU use, and show live local system telemetry in Settings.
assumptions: GPU presets keep the same quality settings as CPU presets; only runtime-oriented values such as recognition batch size differ.
Telemetry is local live diagnostics only: no remote reporting, no database history, and no periodic background collection outside Settings.
If OCR GPU compatibility fails, the app must block GPU selection and report the reason instead of silently falling back to CPU.
Existing uncommitted changes predate this tracker update and must be preserved.

current_tasks.task: Add OCR GPU capability detection shared by settings save, diagnostics, and provisioning.
current_tasks.done_when: Backend reports GPU absent, incompatible, CUDA runtime invalid, or usable with a clear block reason.

current_tasks.task: Block OCR GPU settings when compatibility fails.
current_tasks.done_when: UI disables GPU with a reason, and PUT /api/settings/ocr rejects device=gpu unless the backend GPU check passes.

current_tasks.task: Split OCR presets by device while keeping balanced as the default for both CPU and GPU.
current_tasks.done_when: CPU keeps current fast/balanced/accurate values; GPU uses the same quality values with higher recognition batch sizes: fast=8, balanced=12, accurate=16.
paddle_ocr_bridge.py --mode check --device gpu reports compiledWithCuda=true, cudaDeviceCount > 0, activeDevice=gpu, and useful Paddle package versions.

current_tasks.task: Repair OCR GPU provisioning so CPU and GPU Paddle wheels cannot mask each other.
current_tasks.done_when: GPU provisioning uninstalls both paddlepaddle and paddlepaddle-gpu, installs the selected GPU wheel, verifies CUDA, and reports CPU fallback reasons in auto mode.
Settings shows CPU usage, logical CPU count, RAM total/free, C: disk total/free, GPU name/driver/utilization/memory, and OCR GPU compatibility state.

current_tasks.task: Update tests and docs for OCR GPU blocking, device presets, bridge diagnostics, provisioning, and telemetry.
current_tasks.done_when: Relevant backend, frontend unit, and build checks pass and docs describe the new GPU behavior.
